brief: Nine slice parchment panel. This is now the journal page itself, so every entry is read on it. Lighter than the wood panel, same 8px corners, and the centre must be plain enough to put handwriting-style text on.
sketchNote: A nine-slice, same cuts as the wood panel, lighter because every journal entry is read on top of it. Outline, a mid inner border, then a flat fill. The four = dots are MARKERS showing the corners of the 8x8 centre that stretches the most. Do not paint them. Keep everything inside that square one flat colour or it smears when stretched.
